goal: Recover the perfect-foresight gap using REAL archived day-ahead weather forecasts as a causal future covariate. Honest RTO-7 test MASE is 0.572; the oracle (perfect weather + renewables) ceiling is 0.468. Close at least half that gap without leakage and without degrading held-out BAs.

baseline.note: 7 RTOs, 2025 test split, causal covariates, deduplicated store.

success.primary: RTO-7 test MASE <= 0.52 (>= 50% of the 0.572 -> 0.468 gap closed)
success.must_not_regress: holdout_gap worse by more than 0.02; cov_pi80 below 0.75
success.must_beat: Chronos-2 zero-shot given the SAME forecast covariates — otherwise the gain belongs to the covariate, not to surge.

eval_contract.split: validation (calendar 2024). Test (2025) is reserved for a single final confirmation via {"confirm": true}.
eval_contract.rejects: future_mode='oracle', and any setup whose future covariates change when post-origin actuals are perturbed

hard_constraints: The forecast covariate at hour t must be the value forecast at or before t-horizon. Never substitute the observed series or the reanalysis - that is the oracle leak.
Train and serve on the SAME covariate kind. Training on observed temperature and serving a forecast is the train/serve mismatch that made every causal proxy lose to withholding temperature entirely.
Because the forecast archive starts 2021-03, retrain on 2021-2023 and keep val=2024 and test=2025 unchanged so results stay comparable to results.tsv.
Never score on test during search. Validation only; one final confirmation.
Always report Chronos-2 zero-shot with the same covariates as the control.

ideas.rationale: Day-ahead forecast temp has MAE ~1.3C and corr ~0.99 against the analysis, so it should capture most of the 0.084 MASE that oracle temperature was worth. This is the single largest measured lever.
ideas.try: ingest temperature_2m_previous_day1 for the 7 RTO centroids 2021-03..2026-04; declare it known-future; retrain so the model learns to trust it appropriately.

ideas.rationale: Oracle wind/solar was worth a further 0.043 MASE. Open-Meteo exposes shortwave radiation and 100m wind speed as forecast variables, which proxy solar and wind output causally.
46 of 53 BAs have zero-filled weather. Forecast covariates can cover all 53 from Open-Meteo centroids without needing the ASOS backfill at all.
ideas.try: fetch forecast temp for all 53 BA centroids, not just the RTOs.

ideas.rationale: Measured 8% degradation from Jan-Apr 2025 to Jan-Apr 2026 for both surge and zero-shot. Literature (arXiv 2607.15705) finds continuous retraining materially important and commonly overlooked.
ideas.try: rolling monthly LoRA re-adaptation; 37s per run makes this nearly free.

ideas.rationale: TabPFN-TS (11M params) claims SOTA on covariate-informed forecasting on GIFT-Eval and fev-bench, and reportedly captures simple covariate-target relations better than Chronos-2 at short horizons.
ideas.try: evaluate with identical covariates; consider cross-family output ensembling.

ideas.rationale: SOTA cannot be claimed on a self-defined BA set with a self-computed denominator. Needs a benchmark with published numbers.
ideas.try: GEFCom2014-L (probabilistic, pinball loss), fev-bench/GIFT-Eval covariate tracks, or the frozen German live-challenge leaderboard (arXiv 2608.05018).

measured_inputs.weather_forecast_source: Open-Meteo Previous Runs API, temperature_2m_previous_day1 (GFS seamless) — the forecast issued ~24h before valid time
measured_inputs.archive_start: 2021-03 for GFS 2m temperature; ~2024-01 for most other models
